column1: # Performance budget: the commands scripts/perf-gate.sh times (make perf-gate).
# Command rows are tab-separated:
#   name <TAB> ceiling_ms <TAB> command <TAB> stdin (optional, one line)
# - command runs from the tree root with no shell: words split on spaces.
# - ceiling_ms is the hard limit for the fastest run on any machine. It is
#   about 2x the value on the owner's Mac (2026-11-09) and stops slow drift
#   across many PRs. Raise it only with a reason in the PR.
# - Every command must be side-effect free and offline. It runs with an empty
#   environment and a scratch HOME.
# - `dotfiles help` is not here on purpose: it starts the update check, which
#   can fetch from the network.
# A new hot-path command joins this file in the PR that adds it.
dotfiles-version
dotfiles-config
heavy-run-status
hook-require-heavy-run
hook-block-dangerous-git
# Runtime paths: the gate times the commands only when the diff touches one.
# The gate uses this list and the list at the merge-base together. config/ is
# here because bin/dotfiles-config reads config/settings.yaml.
PERF_GATE_PATH=bin/
PERF_GATE_PATH=lib/
PERF_GATE_PATH=agent-hooks/
PERF_GATE_PATH=git-hooks/
PERF_GATE_PATH=config/
PERF_GATE_PATH=scripts/perf-gate.sh
PERF_GATE_PATH=scripts/perf-gate.pl
# Allow section: one line per intended slowdown above 10% in this PR.
#   PERF_GATE_ALLOW=<name>:<reason>
# The ceiling still applies. A line counts when the base does not have the
# same line (same name and reason). The gate stops on a line that the base
# has unchanged: the next PR removes it, or writes its own reason.
# A row removed from this file needs an allow line too. An allow line that
# names no command is an error.
# A PR that changes scripts/perf-gate.sh, scripts/perf-gate.pl, or
# tests/perf-gate.bats changes its own judge. It needs the line
# PERF_GATE_ALLOW=perf-gate:<reason>.
PERF_GATE_ALLOW=perf-gate:two-rule estimator (min and paired median), prune of old unmarked cache folders, checked lock wait in one test
